title: Sweedler Duality for BiHom-associative Algebras
summary: Motivated by the fact that ordinary linear duality does not in general produce a coalgebra structure from an infinite-dimensional algebra, we develop a Sweedler-type finite dual construction for BiHom-associative algebras. For a BiHom-algebra $(G,μ,α,β)$ over a field, we define its Sweedler dual $G^{\circ}\subseteq G^{*}$ as the subspace of linear functionals annihilating a finite-codimensional BiHom-ideal of $G$.
